answer: Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the gale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing.
